_comment: Uses this widget's own token, then the variable token_env names, which defaults to $GITHUB_TOKEN. It does not read any other widget's section. Each source is one GitHub search; results are pooled and de-duplicated, because GitHub search has no OR. @mine expands to every org you belong to plus your own account.
_token_comment: This widget's GitHub token. Empty falls through to the variable token_env names, not to another widget's token.
_token_env_comment: Which environment variable holds the token, when `token` is empty. Defaults to GITHUB_TOKEN. This is a variable name, never a credential.
_sources_comment: Named GitHub search queries pooled and de-duplicated into the follow-up queue.
_limit_comment: Maximum pull requests retained after searches are combined.
